Bulletin No: 07 MWA/26/08/01/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for Strong Winds and Rough Seas
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 10.30 p.m. 01 August 2026
Valid for the period until 10.30 p.m. 02 August 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Puttalam to Pottuvil via Colombo,
Galle and Hambantota
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Puttalam to Pottuvil via
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will
be rough or very rough at times with
strong gusty winds up to (55-65)
kmph.
The naval and fishing communities
who are engaged in fishing and naval
activities in the above sea areas are
requested to be vigilant in this regard
and be attentive to future forecasts
issued by the Department of
Meteorology in this regard.
